package postgres

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestProgrammingFoundationMigrationIsExactNeutralPublishedGraph(t *testing.T) {
	payload, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/008_programming_foundation_graph.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	migration := string(payload)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"'programming.foundation', 'v1', 'programming-foundation-graph-v1', 'Основы программирования'",
		"'programming.execution-state'", "'programming.values-expressions'", "'programming.control-flow'",
		"'programming.functions-decomposition'", "'programming.collections-iteration'", "'programming.debugging-feedback'",
		"'PUBLISHED'", "ON CONFLICT", "RAISE EXCEPTION", "INSERT INTO target_prerequisite",
		"FROM learning_target_stack", "EXCEPT",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(migration, required) {
			t.Fatalf("foundation migration is missing %q", required)
		}
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{
		"INSERT INTO transition_knowledge", "INSERT INTO learning_target_stack",
		"'go.'", "'javascript.'", "'python.'", "course_id", "lesson_id",
	} {
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(migration), strings.ToLower(forbidden)) {
			t.Fatalf("foundation migration contains forbidden stack/content identity %q", forbidden)
		}
	}
	if strings.Count(migration, "'programming.execution-state'") < 5 {
		t.Fatal("foundation migration must verify its exact target and topology, not only insert it")
	}
	down, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/008_programming_foundation_graph.down.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, target := range []string{
		"programming.execution-state", "programming.values-expressions", "programming.control-flow",
		"programming.functions-decomposition", "programming.collections-iteration", "programming.debugging-feedback",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(string(down), target) {
			t.Fatalf("down migration does not own exact target %q", target)
		}
	}
}

func TestGoBackendPublishedSeedFingerprintIsUnchanged(t *testing.T) {
	payload, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/002_standard_v1_seed.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(payload)
	const expected = "e10a1370edcb4d69a604c101123de2b9b0b5b9fa4e3bb25e7760a50f1f338872"
	if actual := hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]); actual != expected {
		t.Fatalf("go.backend published seed fingerprint changed: %s", actual)
	}
}
